emotional_core: The quiet frustration of doing the work and still plateauing — and the relief of realizing it's a level problem, not a discipline problem.
visual_metaphor: A spiral staircase versus a treadmill — one creates altitude with each step, one burns energy while staying at exactly the same level.
key_quotes: When your improvement process improves itself, you stop needing willpower to sustain it.
Behavior follows identity. If your self-concept doesn't update as you improve, you'll unconsciously self-sabotage back to whoever you used to be.
The test: after consuming something, do you know something new, or do you see something differently? The second one compounds. The first one evaporates.

story_frames.visual: Person on a treadmill, fully equipped, working hard — overhead shot, warm morning light, clear effort. The belt moves. They stay in place. Metaphor for single-layer improvement rendered as a literal image.
story_frames.text: The treadmill runs. You don't move.

story_frames.visual: Close-up of a hand underlining a single sentence in a book — not highlighting, underlining with deliberate pressure. Stack of books in soft focus behind. Morning light from the left.
Overhead flat-lay: running shoes, journal, water bottle, phone face-down — each object touching the next in a horizontal chain. Clean surface, warm tone. The chain structure is the point.
Open journal spread: left page headed 'What I expected' with confident handwriting, right page headed 'What actually happened' with honest corrections. Gap between the two is visible and honest.
Network diagram drawn on a whiteboard — nodes of varying sizes connected by edges. One central node noticeably larger with many more connections than the others. Hand visible at the edge, mid-draw.

Person standing at a mirror, but their reflection stands slightly differently — same clothes, same face, but posture shifted forward, bearing more settled. No dramatic transformation. Just a quiet update.
Spiral staircase viewed from directly below — each step visible, ascending into soft light. No destination shown. The movement itself is the subject.
story_frames.text: This is what compounding actually looks like.
